en: Sepia panoramic view of a seaport and customs area mounted on a cardstock border. On the left, several long wooden piers extend into a calm bay with hills in the background and a simple shed-like structure in the foreground. On the right, a wide dusty waterfront street with scattered pedestrians runs past low buildings and trees, with a larger house or public building at the far end and a tall flagpole or mast. The bottom margin carries printed captions in Bulgarian and French, and there are official circular stamps on the mount.
